name: SNS
recent: SNS Network 在 2026 年 9 月底公布季度业绩并宣派第一次中期股息每股 0.25 仙，同期 Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments 多次申报大股东权益变动。公司也出现董事在闭门期表达交易意向及公司秘书变更。
notable: 宣派第一次中期股息每股 0.25 仙，除息日为 2026 年 11 月 4 日，派发日为 2026 年 11 月 26 日。
Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments Berhad 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月间多次申报大股东权益变动。
公司秘书由 Chong Kwai Yoong 变更。
risks: 董事总经理 Ko Yun Hung 及执行董事 Pah Wai Onn 在闭门期表达交易意向。
新闻标题显示 2Q 净利同比下滑 37%，受成本上升和交付延迟影响。
earnings: 2026 财年截至 7 月 31 日的季度营收为 RM801.78 million，环比增长 80.2%，同比减少 2.5%；净利为 RM12.89 million，环比增长 376.3%，同比增长 25.8%，净利率为 1.6%。

recent_en: SNS Network announced quarterly results and a first interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share in late September 2026, while Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments filed multiple substantial shareholder changes. There were also directors' intentions to deal during closed periods and a change of company secretary.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share, with ex-date on 4 November 2026 and payment date on 26 November 2026.
Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments Berhad filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between September and November 2026.
Change of company secretary from Chong Kwai Yoong.
risks_en: Managing Director Ko Yun Hung and Executive Director Pah Wai Onn expressed intentions to deal during closed periods.
News headlines indicate 2Q net profit fell 37% year-on-year on higher costs and delivery delays.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM801.78 million, up 80.2% QoQ but down 2.5% YoY; net income was RM12.89 million, up 376.3% QoQ and 25.8% YoY, with a net margin of 1.6%.
